info.title: Nexora platform API
info.description: Rust self-hosted platform: local/corporate OIDC identity and individual actor keys; separate GitHub/GitLab consent; projects and registered code/knowledge reads through REST/MCP; versioned configurable workflows without roles; tasks/backlogs, dependencies/comments/templates, exact optional human approvals and approval requests; explicit task movement/workflow migration; structured versioned requirements/business rules/documents with pinned source evidence, traceability and deterministic exports/context packages. Local snapshots retain original runtime identity through operator attestation. Real external-provider consent is not implied by local fixture tests. Developer machines use remote MCP configuration and skills with their existing Git; the operational CLI stays server-side. Task branch preparation/reporting is available through MCP only and records agent_reported provenance, not independent Git verification. Authenticated GitHub/GitLab source webhooks atomically enqueue durable analysis requests; server workers index their exact commit automatically. Webhook jobs expose source_event_id and use current source consent, not developer login credentials; no automatic OpenAI evaluation. Isolated service-request workspace for user/supervisor roles, shared conversation and evidence, and IT-only task/feature links; requests never enter task workflows.
